title: C# and .NET Interview Prep
description: Practice mid-level C# and .NET interview concepts through code-reading drills, architecture scenarios, and review prompts.
outcomes: Explain C# runtime and type-system fundamentals in interview language
Map ASP.NET Core endpoint, service, validation, and authorization responsibilities
Reason about EF Core indexes, migrations, transactions, and outbox patterns
Practice mid-level debugging, code review, and system design answers
Choose unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for .NET service behavior
Discuss production readiness through logging, metrics, performance, caching, and secrets
